svg.text: Lopes upright, drops to all fours to sprint.
Hunts in packs of 20–50 that flow around
obstacles like water. Head twitches between lunges.
Skitters in short bursts, freezes, then pounces.
Climbs corpse piles fastest: always the
Slow, heavy knuckle-walk; camera shakes per step.
Charges doors shoulder-first in a straight line.
Cannot turn mid-charge: bait it into blast doors.
Plods, then stops to roar, enraging nearby aliens.
Wide fist sweeps scatter walls and colonists.
Carries old spears and wounds from past colonies.
Stilted, wading gait; hangs back behind the swarm.
Keeps max range from turrets. Tell: stops and
inflates throat sac for 1s before firing.
Leans forward and lobs acid in an arc over walls.
Acid pools burn for 4s. Sac visibly drains;
retreats to refill after three shots.
Ignores turrets; heads straight for the most
Grabs an ankle, drags backward at half speed
toward the map edge, leaving a blood trail.
Kill it and the colonist crawls home.
Swims under the ground as a moving dirt ripple.
Erupts behind walls, rakes with digging claws,
2s tell: ground cracks, amber glow leaks out.
Seismic turrets force it to surface early,
Lumbers forward, stopping to feed on every corpse
and growing larger each time. Young cling to her
and drop off as Stalkers every few seconds.
Topples forward; the sac ruptures and spills
dying young and a huge ichor pool that stays
on the map. Flies arrive within seconds.
